title: Saints GM Mickey Loomis: We're trying to see how Alvin Kamara fits on our roster

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Saints GM Mickey Loomis: We're trying to see how Alvin Kamara fits on our roster
sources.description: Running back Alvin Kamara sounds like he wants to be with the Saints for the 2026 season, but it remains less than a sure thing that is how all will play out in New Orleans.
